label: US passport (original, unexpired)
notes: Accepted primary identity document for REAL ID.

label: Certified US birth certificate (original, with raised seal)
notes: Must be certified with seal. Hospital souvenir certificates not accepted.

label: Certificate of Naturalization (N-550 / N-570)
Certificate of Citizenship (N-560 / N-561)
Consular Report of Birth Abroad (FS-240 / DS-1350 / FS-545)
Permanent Resident Card (I-551 / green card)
Valid visa with passport and I-94 (and EAD if applicable)
Original Social Security card (copies not accepted)
notes: Must be the original physical card. A W-2, 1099, or pay stub with SSN is acceptable only in very limited REAL ID fallback scenarios — ask clerk.

label: Proof of St. Lucie County residential address #1 (deed, mortgage statement, lease, current utility bill, voter registration card, bank statement, or official mail dated within 60 days)
notes: FLHSMV requires TWO proofs of Florida residential address, each from a different source. Must show residency of more than 30 days and be dated within 60 days.

label: Proof of St. Lucie County residential address #2 (from a different source than #1)
notes: FLHSMV requires two documents from different sources.

label: Declaration of Domicile from the St. Lucie County Clerk of the Circuit Court — substitutes for one of the required proofs of FL address
notes: FLHSMV requires TWO proofs of Florida residential address (from different sources). This Declaration of Domicile substitutes for a proof you're missing. Get it from the Clerk of Court's Recording Department: fill it out, get it notarized, then record it at the Clerk's office before your tax collector visit.

label: Certified marriage certificate (for name change; church-issued not accepted)
Certified divorce decree (for name change)
Certified court order of name change
Current out-of-state driver license
Certified driving record from prior state (required when license cannot be verified in NLETS)
Corrective lenses (if needed) OR completed HSMV 72010 Report of Eye Examination
Copy of military orders (active-duty service members)
Application for Certificate of Title (HSMV 82040)
VIN and Odometer Verification (HSMV 82042)
notes: Required for out-of-state vehicles. Must be completed by FL DMV compliance examiner, FL licensed dealer, FL notary, law enforcement officer, or US Military Police. Not required if vehicle is brought to the office parking lot for on-site VIN verification.

label: Power of Attorney for a Motor Vehicle, Mobile Home, Vessel, or Vessel with Trailer (HSMV 82053)
Notice of Sale / Bill of Sale (HSMV 82050)
notes: Required when purchaser name is missing from the title assignment or when odometer disclosure needs a separate document.

label: Original vehicle title, signed by all registered owners (photocopies not accepted)
Current out-of-state registration (dated within the last 6 months)
Bill of sale or purchase agreement
notes: Used to prove sales tax paid out of state (if owned less than 6 months) and/or to supply odometer disclosure when the title is missing it.

label: Proof of sales tax paid in previous state (bill of sale, dealer invoice, or tax receipt)
notes: Applies only when vehicle owned less than 6 months. Without proof, FL collects full 6% Use Tax + local option tax.

label: Lienholder letter on letterhead with VIN, make, and year (or copy of OOS title showing the lien)
Lease agreement plus lessor letter authorizing Florida 'Registration Only' (VIN, make, and year must appear in the letter)
Proof of current Florida PDL and PIP insurance (insurance ID card with company name + policy number)
Sunbiz 'active' registration printout for the business (showing registered agents)
notes: Required when title will be in a business name.

label: Certification of Trust or full Trust Agreement
notes: Required when title will be held in a trust.

label: All trustees present in person OR power of attorney for absent trustees
Adult (18+) co-purchaser present to sign the title application
notes: Required when the primary purchaser is a minor.

label: All applicants present with their government-issued photo ID
Valid government-issued photo ID for each person signing
Current Florida driver license or ID
DOT medical examiner's certificate uploaded to the Florida system (by the examining physician's office)
notes: FL cannot accept the paper card at the counter; the physician's office must upload it to the state system.

label: Pass the CDL General Knowledge written exam (in English, cannot be taken in audio form)
Pass the CDL skills (driving) exam
notes: Not eligible until CLP has been held for 2 weeks.

label: CDL application fee ($75, plus $7 per endorsement)
CDL late fee (required when CDL has been expired less than 1 year)
TSA background check fee for hazmat endorsement ($91)
Pass the Hazmat written test (valid only 60 days; available in English or Spanish; may be taken in audio form)
notes: The Walton office does NOT have a hazmat testing machine.

label: School employment ID card OR letter from the school department on letterhead
notes: Required on every original and renewal for school-bus endorsement applicants.

label: Valid out-of-state CDL (from a US state or territory)
$7 endorsement fee for each CDL endorsement requested
Notarized power of attorney document (original signature or DocuSigned) authorizing someone other than the owner to sign title paperwork
Odometer disclosure — completed on HSMV 82050 bill of sale if not present on the title
Current Florida driver license or ID card (the credential you are renewing)
Renew online at MyDMV Portal (https://mydmvportal.flhsmv.gov/). Credential mailed within 2-3 weeks. $2 online processing fee applies in addition to the renewal fee.
notes: Only offered every other renewal cycle per FLHSMV policy. If customer used online last time, they must come in-office.

label: DD-214 discharge document (any member-copy) or VA-issued veteran ID card to add the 'V' designation
VA letter documenting 100% total and permanent service-connected disability rating (required for no-fee credential per §322.21)
Confirmation that your Social Security Administration record already reflects your new name (FLHSMV will cross-check this at the counter; visit SSA before your office appointment if not yet done)
notes: Pre-requisite task, not a document — the customer must have visited the Social Security Administration and updated their name before coming to the tax collector. SSA card does not need to be presented (only original one for REAL ID verification).

label: Proof of completion of the Traffic Law & Substance Abuse Education (TLSAE) or Driver Education Traffic Safety (DETS) course from an FLHSMV-approved provider
notes: Approved providers report completion electronically to FLHSMV; no physical certificate required at counter. Required for any first-time licensee who has never held a DL in any state or country.

label: Parent Proctoring Form (HSMV 71144) — notarized OR signed in front of a driver license examiner — for online Class E knowledge exam by applicants under 18
Parental Consent for Driver Application of a Minor (HSMV 71142) — signed with parent/guardian present, in office
Parent or legal guardian must bring a valid government-issued photo ID to co-sign for the minor applicant
Schedule the in-office Class E knowledge exam (50 questions, 80% required to pass, English only) at your driver license service center
notes: Not a document — an in-office exam appointment. $30 first-attempt fee (standard Class E learner application).

label: Current or most-recent vehicle registration OR renewal notice (copy acceptable)
IRS Form 2290 showing the Heavy Vehicle Use Tax has been paid (or proof of exemption, e.g., vehicle purchased within 60 days)
notes: Required for vehicles with GVW of 55,000 lbs or more. Must match the VIN on registration and insurance; no alterations accepted.

label: Commercial-vehicle insurance policy with correct coverage limits (ACORD Form, Certificate of Liability, or FMCSA Self-Insurance proof)
Military Insurance Exemption Affidavit (HSMV 71061) for active-duty service members using out-of-state insurance
Physical out-of-state vehicle title for surrender to Florida
VIN verification (HSMV 82042) — can be completed in-office by the clerk, or in advance by law enforcement, a Florida notary, or a licensed dealer
US Customs import documentation for foreign-country vehicles — EPA 3520-1, DOT HS-7, CBP 7501 entry summary
Initial Registration Fee Exemption Affidavit (HSMV 82002) — signed by applicant for §320.072 exemption
Certified death certificate of the deceased spouse (for surviving-spouse exemption)
The existing physical license plate you are transferring (or the plate number if the plate is not in hand)
Florida Specialty License Plate packet — review available plates and eligibility requirements
VA Summary of Benefits letter specifying either (1) 100% service-connected disability, (2) compensated at the 100% rate, OR (3) DVA-financed vehicle purchase

Police report OR police business card with case number documenting the theft
The physical license plate being surrendered

License Plate Surrender Affidavit pre-signed by the registered owner/co-owner (if not surrendering in person)
The gift recipient's name AND either their license plate number or their driver license number
Application for Duplicate or Lost-in-Transit / Reassignment of a Motor Vehicle, Mobile Home or Vessel Title Certificate (HSMV 82101)
notes: Used for duplicate titles. Must be signed by all owners if title is joined by 'and'.

label: Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin (for new vehicles from a dealer) OR properly signed-over out-of-state title

Application for Disabled Person Parking Permit (HSMV 83039) — top section by you; medical certification by a physician (MD/DO), physician assistant, chiropractor, podiatrist, advanced-practice RN, or optometrist (sight conditions only). Signature must be dated within the last 12 months.
Existing parking-placard number (for renewal tracking)
Your Florida driver license or Florida ID card

Photo ID (any one): driver license or ID from your state of residence; valid US passport or passport card; or a DL/ID from American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Marianas, Puerto Rico, or the US Virgin Islands
Copy of the registration for your expiring parking permit
notes: Required for renewals — the F-83039 Renewal Instructions list this alongside a fresh medical certification.

Police report listing the stolen placard (waives the $1 replacement fee)
Copy of your current parking permit issued by your country of residence

Payment: $1 replacement fee

Physical out-of-state vessel title to surrender to Florida

Walton Road office — road-test parking guide PDF

Guaranteed funds (cashier's check, cash, debit, or credit) — personal checks NOT accepted for delinquent taxes

Partial Payment Affidavit for property taxes — minimum $100 per payment, up to 3 payments, no discounts apply

Tax Collector Real Estate Change of Address form (tcslc.com) — submitted AFTER the Property Appraiser form
Personal check accepted for current-year tax payments (not for delinquent taxes)

Current mobile home registration and decal number (for decal transfer)
Declaration of Mobile Home as Real Property (DR-402) — issued by the St. Lucie County Property Appraiser BEFORE applying for an RP decal
Apply for a Real Property (RP) decal at the tax collector — $5.10, permanent as long as the mobile home is not moved

Firearms-training certificate (NRA firearms safety/training course, hunter safety/education course, law-enforcement firearms course, state-certified instructor course, or organized shooting competition documentation) — must include applicant name, instructor name, instructor qualifications and license/certification number

FDACS CCW license fee (payment by check/money order or the payment methods accepted by your tax collector — regional offices don't accept cash; tax collectors may charge an additional convenience fee of up to $22)
Current Florida concealed-weapon license (for renewal)
DD-214 (for honorably-discharged veterans) OR current call-to-active-duty orders and statement of military service (for active-duty servicemembers age 18-20)
FWC license fee (varies by category and duration — see myfwc.com)

Business Tax Receipt application fee (amount varies by classification — apply online at stlucie.county-taxes.com/btexpress for exact amount)
Your existing BTR account number (search by business name at stlucie.county-taxes.com to locate)
Business Tax Receipt Closure JotForm (linked from tcslc.com /227/Local-Business-Tax)
City of Port St. Lucie Business Tax receipt (772-344-4356 — cityofpsl.com/government/departments/financial-management-department/business-tax-division)
City of Fort Pierce Certificate of Use (772-467-3065 — cityoffortpierce.com/141/Applications-and-Forms)
St. Lucie Village Business Tax receipt (772-466-6900 — stlucievillagefl.gov/online-forms/)

St. Lucie County Fire District inspection for commercial locations (772-621-3377 — slcfd.com)
State-issued professional license appropriate to your regulated profession (DBPR, FDACS, DOH, etc.)

label: Apply online at https://stlucie.county-taxes.com/btexpress — fees are calculated automatically based on the business classification you select.
File online at the St. Lucie Tourist Development Tax portal (stlucie.county-taxes.com/tourist) — quarterly returns and payments are processed electronically.
Proof of business entity — any one of: FEID number, FL sales-tax registration number, or Sunbiz active-registration printout
Trust certification or trust agreement showing the trustee's authority to transfer title
Certified weight slip from a public scale (CAT scale at a truck stop, county weigh station, or commercial scale) showing the trailer's empty net weight
notes: Required for any trailer registration. The 2,000-lb cutoff between registration-only and title-required is determined by this slip. CAT scales at most truck stops will provide one for ~$15.

label: Receipts for parts purchased to build the trailer (frame, axles, wheels, lights, hitch, hardware) — used to calculate 6% sales tax basis
notes: Florida charges 6% sales tax on the total material cost for homemade trailers. Bring every receipt you have. If receipts are incomplete, the office may estimate from market value at clerk's discretion.

label: Bill of sale signed by the previous owner showing trailer description (make/model/year/VIN if any), purchase price, and date
notes: Used to calculate 6% sales tax basis on a private-purchase trailer. For trailers <2,000 lb, this is the primary proof of ownership (no title exists).

label: Dealer bill of sale showing trailer description, purchase price, and dealer-collected sales tax
notes: Dealers collect FL sales tax at point of sale and provide a bill of sale showing the breakdown. Tax collector verifies tax was collected; otherwise calculates and collects at the counter.

label: Original Florida trailer title from the prior owner, signed over to the customer (photocopies not accepted)
notes: Required for trailers ≥2,000 lb that already have a Florida title. Seller signs the back; customer brings to tax collector.

label: Certified death certificate of the owner named on the title
notes: Inheritance/deceased-owner title transfer. Confirmed by St. Lucie tax-office testers (tax423/tax424) as required to establish the owner is deceased. The ADDITIONAL estate documents beyond the death certificate (will, Letters of Administration, FLHSMV decedent affidavit) depend on the survivorship / will / probate path and are confirmed at the counter — see vehicle-title-transfer.review.md for the per-path checklist still to be finalized with the office.
